%==================================================================
% Modern variant — preamble (DO NOT EDIT, except accent color in style.tex)
% Extends ATS base with: xcolor accent, fontawesome5 icons, graphicx photo.
% Still single-column (email/networking friendly, NOT for strict ATS portal).
%==================================================================
\input{templates/modern/style}

\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage[utf8]{inputenc}
\usepackage{lmodern}
\renewcommand{\familydefault}{\sfdefault}

\usepackage{geometry}
\geometry{left=\MarginSize, top=1.5cm, right=\MarginSize, bottom=1.5cm}

\usepackage{xcolor}
\definecolor{accent}{rgb}{\AccentColor}

\usepackage{titlesec}
\titleformat{\section}{\SectionFontSize\color{accent}}{}{0pt}{}[\color{accent}\titlerule]
\titlespacing*{\section}{0pt}{10pt}{4pt}

\usepackage{enumitem}
\setlist[itemize]{nosep, leftmargin=1.2em, topsep=2pt}
\setlist[enumerate]{nosep, leftmargin=1.4em, topsep=2pt}

\usepackage{fontawesome5}
\usepackage{graphicx}

\usepackage[colorlinks=true, linkcolor=accent, urlcolor=accent, pdftex]{hyperref}
\urlstyle{same}

\usepackage{ifthen}

% --- Contact fallbacks: %-commented fields in config/personal.tex = empty ---
\providecommand{\cvName}{}
\providecommand{\cvTagline}{}
\providecommand{\cvLocation}{}
\providecommand{\cvPhone}{}
\providecommand{\cvEmail}{}
\providecommand{\ShowPhoto}{false}
\providecommand{\photoPath}{}
% Legacy single-field names (backward compat with old personal.tex)
\providecommand{\cvGithub}{}
\providecommand{\cvLinkedin}{}
\providecommand{\cvWebsite}{}
% New Url/Label pairs (alias support: href uses Url, display uses Label)
\providecommand{\cvGithubUrl}{}
\providecommand{\cvGithubLabel}{}
\providecommand{\cvLinkedinUrl}{}
\providecommand{\cvLinkedinLabel}{}
\providecommand{\cvWebsiteUrl}{}
\providecommand{\cvWebsiteLabel}{}
% Bridge legacy -> Url/Label when only old names are defined
\ifthenelse{\equal{\cvGithubUrl}{}}{%
  \ifthenelse{\equal{\cvGithub}{}}{}{\renewcommand{\cvGithubUrl}{\cvGithub}}%
}{}
\ifthenelse{\equal{\cvGithubLabel}{}}{%
  \ifthenelse{\equal{\cvGithubUrl}{}}{}{\renewcommand{\cvGithubLabel}{\cvGithubUrl}}%
}{}
\ifthenelse{\equal{\cvLinkedinUrl}{}}{%
  \ifthenelse{\equal{\cvLinkedin}{}}{}{\renewcommand{\cvLinkedinUrl}{\cvLinkedin}}%
}{}
\ifthenelse{\equal{\cvLinkedinLabel}{}}{%
  \ifthenelse{\equal{\cvLinkedinUrl}{}}{}{\renewcommand{\cvLinkedinLabel}{\cvLinkedinUrl}}%
}{}
\ifthenelse{\equal{\cvWebsiteUrl}{}}{%
  \ifthenelse{\equal{\cvWebsite}{}}{}{\renewcommand{\cvWebsiteUrl}{\cvWebsite}}%
}{}
\ifthenelse{\equal{\cvWebsiteLabel}{}}{%
  \ifthenelse{\equal{\cvWebsiteUrl}{}}{}{\renewcommand{\cvWebsiteLabel}{\cvWebsiteUrl}}%
}{}

% --- Separator + conditional join + clickable-link helpers ---
\newcommand{\cvSep}{\enspace\textbar\enspace}
\newif\ifcvNeedSep
\newcommand{\cvItem}[1]{\ifcvNeedSep\cvSep\fi#1\cvNeedSeptrue}
% \cvLink{bare-url}{label} — pass bare domain (no https://), joins with \cvSep
\newcommand{\cvLink}[2]{\href{https://#1}{#2}}

\newcommand{\datedEntry}[4]{%
  \noindent\textbf{#1}\hfill{\SmallFontSize #2}\\%
  {\SmallFontSize\textit{#3}\hfill\textit{#4}}\vspace{2pt}\par%
}
\pagestyle{empty}
\setlength{\parindent}{0pt}
\setlength{\parskip}{3pt}
